scope: PDV, caixas, relatórios, modais, configurações do PDV e controles de tela dos recibos
review_method: All PDV Blade and modular stylesheets scanned; exact-selector CSS cascade reviewed.

findings.component: PDV custom select triggers and dialog shells
findings.before: Browser detected custom select trigger font14px/border#c8d3dc, diverging from the canonical13.5px/#cbd6df; high-specificity dialog shells used control-border.
findings.after: Existing rules include .ui-select-trigger in discount approval, sales, cash opening, overdue cash, cancellation, operations and electronic forms; fonts/borders use common tokens. Dialog shells consume --ui-card-border.

findings.component: PDV modal primary and sales filter/pager actions
findings.before: Browser detected modal primary font14px because .pdv-body button inherited font over the less-specific component selector; sales Apply/Today used28px/font10 and Previous/Next29px/font10. Green primary had a blue local border.
findings.after: Original modal-primary selector has explicit PDV specificity, shared13.5px font,12px horizontal padding,7px gap and success border/background tokens. Existing sales filter/pager rules use34px and shared13.5px font. Checkout-specific sizes preserved. No pdv-modal-secondary component exists in Blade/CSS/JS sources.
findings.status: implemented; validated by the shared browser matrix and targeted rechecks recorded in this audit

findings.component: PDV customer search, checkout identification and prominent monetary inputs
findings.before: Browser detected customer search50px/radius0/font14, identification52px, and equivalent prominent money inputs58px/font24 and62px/font26.
findings.after: Customer search uses regular38px/radius4/font13.5 without ID-specific appearance. Checkout identification uses a42px component. Both money fields share .pdv-money-control with56px/font24 tokens. IDs/handlers/alignment retained; normal confirmation and skip actions38px.
findings.status: implemented; validated by the shared browser matrix and targeted rechecks recorded in this audit

findings.component: PDV common dialog headers and operation rows
findings.before: Browser screenshot showed gray PDV dialog header/title18 while shared ERP header is teal/title15; operation title/helper11/9.5px. High-specificity sales/cash-opening title overrides prevented shared typography.
findings.after: Existing common headers, receipt header and cash-report toolbar consume shared teal/white/header tokens. Removed high-specificity cash-opening/sales title overrides. Headings15px/helpers12px; operation titles13.5px/helpers12px. Close controls transparent/white with12% white hover. Payment workspace .pdv-checkout-head remains a distinct functional component.
findings.status: implemented; validated by the shared browser matrix and targeted rechecks recorded in this audit

preserved: All routes, form methods/names, credentials and permission checks.
Cash registers, shifts, sales, reconciliation and pagination behavior.
Fiscal authorization/protocol guards, cancellation and NFC-e actions.
POS-specific large search/keypad/checkout controls remain purpose-specific.
Receipt dynamic58/80mm @page, @media print, .receipt width/padding and height calculation compared to HEAD byte-for-byte.
Cash report A4 @page and print geometry; no shared ERP style asset applied to print.
Company logos, fiscal warnings, receipt notes and footers.
